lang_en:
All I wanted in Kochi was one photo of a Chinese fishing net with nobody in front of it.
But January is peak season, and someone was always posing under the Fort Kochi nets.
I went back at first light and still caught a stranger's shoulder.
NakshIQ said what I'd missed: most Kochi tourists never leave Fort Kochi.
So I went fifteen kilometres out, and in the mangroves the only sound was my paddle.
There a net rose from still water with nobody in front, and that's my photo from Kumbalangi.
Travel intelligence is knowing where the empty frame still is.
NakshIQ.
lang_hi:
कोच्चि में मुझे बस एक फ़ोटो चाहिए थी, चाइनीज़ फ़िशिंग नेट की, जिसके आगे कोई खड़ा न हो।
पर जनवरी यहाँ पीक सीज़न है, और फ़ोर्ट कोच्चि के नेट के आगे हमेशा कोई न कोई पोज़ दे रहा होता था।
मैं अगली सुबह तड़के फिर गया, और फिर भी फ़्रेम में किसी अजनबी का कंधा आ गया।
NakshIQ ने वो बताया जो मुझसे छूट गया था: कोच्चि आने वाले ज़्यादातर टूरिस्ट फ़ोर्ट कोच्चि से बाहर निकलते ही नहीं।
तो मैं पंद्रह किलोमीटर दूर एक गाँव गया, और वहाँ मैंग्रोव में बस मेरे चप्पू की आवाज़ थी।
वहाँ एक नेट शांत पानी से ऊपर उठा, आगे कोई नहीं, और कुंबलंगी की वो फ़ोटो आज मेरे पास है।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस है ये जानना कि खाली फ़्रेम अब भी कहाँ मिलता है।
NakshIQ.

facts.name: Kumbalangi Ecotourism Village
facts.quote: Most Kochi tourists never leave Fort Kochi

shots: Early morning on the Fort Kochi shore: a Chinese fishing net against a pale sky, one blurred stranger's shoulder filling the near corner of the frame, a man in his 30s seen from behind holding up a camera.
Close in early morning light on the man's hands lowering the camera, its screen turned away, his face out of frame.
Wide shot from behind in the morning: the man alone in a small wooden canoe gliding through a narrow mangrove channel, the water still.
Close on his paddle dipping into still water between mangrove roots in morning light, ripples spreading, no one else in frame.
Wide in the morning: a Chinese fishing net lifting out of still water at the village edge with nobody in front of it, the man small on the bank behind his camera, seen from behind.
Wide in the morning: the man sits alone on the bank beside the raised net, camera resting in his lap, seen from behind, the water still.
